text:
maria: Kicking off observability provisioning for the new eu-central-1 GPU cluster (g5 pool). Goal: full logs/metrics/traces integration, baseline dashboards, and alert templates so we can hand this to oncall. Proposed high-level steps: bootstrap infra -> connect log pipeline -> wire metrics remote_write -> deploy tracing collector -> create dashboards + alerts -> smoke test + handoff. Planning apply window Tue 02:00-03:30 UTC.

akshay: quick question — are we reusing the existing Cortex/Gateway in euc1 or spinning up a separate metrics cluster? reuse has cost upside but retention/throughput concerns.

maria: prefer reuse if RBAC/tenant isolation works. if retention needs >30d for perf telemetry, we can create a small dedicated Cortex with 90d. i'll validate retention needs after initial traffic test.

ops-bot: Deploy plan created: PR #4521 (infra/obs/euc1). Apply window requested: 2025-06-12 02:00 UTC -> 03:30 UTC. Rollback checkpoint at 02:30 UTC. Links: https://git.redwood/pr/4521 :gear:

jess: Terraform snippet for the log pipeline (put under infra/obs/euc1/logs.tf). paste below for quick copy: ```resource "aws_kinesis_firehose_delivery_stream" "obs_logs" { name = "euc1-obs-logs" destination = "s3" s3_configuration { bucket_arn = "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-obs-euc1-logs" buffering_size = 5 buffering_interval = 300 } }```

samir: Alert suggestions — minimal set to start: 1) GPU temperature > 85C for 5m 2) GPU memory alloc failure rate > 0.1% 3) Inference p99 latency > 250ms for 2m 4) KV cache hit rate < 40% for 15m 5) Log ingestion lag > 2m. Also add NVLink error count > 0 for 5m.

pri: Handoff checklist for oncall (short): - Verify dashboards render (GPU node, inference latency, kvcache) - Run synthetic traffic at 10r/s for 10min and watch p50/p95/p99 - Confirm logs are arriving in S3 + searchable in Kibana (last 30m) - Trigger alert sim for a CPU spike and confirm pager path - Document runbook pointer: /docs/obs/euc1-handoff.md :page_with_curl:

maria: For dashboards, we'll seed with: 1) cluster overview (nodes, GPU util, free VRAM) 2) workload latency (p50/p95/p99 by model) 3) batch queue depth + batching efficiency 4) KV cache hit-rate by route 5) infra cost burn rate. Anyone volunteering to build the initial Grafana panels?

akshay: I can do cluster overview + GPU util panels. will use prometheus node exporter + nvidia-dcgm metrics.

jess: i'll wire the Kibana templates and a log parsing rule for inference errors (parse model_id, route, error_type). also adding an ingest pipeline to strip PII fields.

omcall-bot: oncall handoff ack: samir is oncall for 2025-06-12 :white_check_mark:

maria: tagging eng-sre and eng-runtime for final review: @eng-sre @eng-runtime — please ack when you review PR + dashboard drafts. after ack we'll schedule the apply in staging then prod. :raised_hands:

samir: acked. i'll be on standby for the apply window and will run the smoke test. if anything looks off we rollback to previous tfstate. :thumbsup:

maria: final note: keep retention settings conservative for the first 72h to avoid surprises (30d metrics, 7d logs hot, archive older logs to glacier). we'll revisit after cost telemetry. Thanks all — will post the PR link + checklist updates shortly.
